items.heading: For a Fresher with Little
items.text: For a fresher with little work experience, a short objective helps because it tells the recruiter which role you want and what proof you already have. A resume coaching site says an objective works well for entry-level applicants and suggests two sentences.

items.heading: Pick the Line Closest
items.text: Pick the line closest to the truth for you and rewrite it in your own words. Do not copy a line that claims a tool or project you have not used.

items.heading: Design and Cad
items.text: Design and CAD: "Mechanical engineering fresher seeking a design engineer trainee role. Built and analysed a gearbox assembly in CAD as my final-year project and aiming to grow into simulation and product design.".

items.heading: Production and Quality
items.text: Production and quality: "Mechanical engineer seeking a production or quality trainee role. Completed a four-week plant internship observing inspection and process control and aiming to learn lean methods.".

items.heading: Maintenance and Plant
items.text: Maintenance and plant: "Mechanical engineer seeking a maintenance trainee role. Documented breakdown causes during a plant internship and aiming to grow into reliability work.".
